about: Copy with headers' key (ADR-0005, decided with the user 2026-10-28): Ctrl+Shift+C, Command+Shift+C on a Mac, outside the key table, so that a grid that hides Copy with headers leaves it to the page and lets a Consumer declare it. The Script Core's alone: the C# core's grid offers Copy with headers from its Context Menu only (ADR-0350 section 5's note of 2026-10-27), so no C# runner reads this kind.
subject: GridKeys
